s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of systemic illness with hematologic abnormalities and skin manifestations, complicated by febrile neutropenia and localized pain
salient_findings: Pancytopenia with severe thrombocytopenia
Eczematous plaques on the chest and proximal right arm
Splenomegaly
Febrile neutropenia with positive blood cultures
Severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder
key_facts: Patient is a 27-year-old woman
Works as an agricultural laborer
Presenting symptoms include fatigue, malaise, anorexia, and epistaxis
Physical examination findings include pallor and eczematous plaques
Splenomegaly 6 cm below the costal margin
Hemoglobin 7.3 g/dL
White-cell count 4.0×10^9/L
Platelets 23×10^9/L
Peripheral-blood smear revealed lymphoblasts
Flow cytometry positive for TdT, CD34, CD19, CD10, CD22, and HLA-DR
Developed febrile neutropenia on day 8
Blood cultures grew coagulase-negative Staphylococcus species and Enterococcus species
Severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder
MRI of the right shoulder demonstrated a focal cystic necrotic lesion

shortlist.label: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by bone marrow evaluation and flow cytometry

shortlist.label: Herpes Zoster
shortlist.why_kept: Suggested by severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder and MRI findings of a focal cystic necrotic lesion

shortlist.label: Pyomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the focal cystic necrotic lesion and severe pain in the right arm

shortlist.label: Osteomyelitis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the severe pain in the right arm and MRI findings

shortlist.label: Septic Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the severe pain in the right arm and MRI findings

shortlist.label: Cellulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the eczematous plaques and severe pain in the right arm

shortlist.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Differential diagnosis for the patient's hematologic abnormalities

shortlist.label: Eczema Herpeticum
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the eczematous plaques, given the patient's history of eczema

raw.rationale: The patient's severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder and the MRI finding of a focal cystic necrotic lesion between the teres minor and teres major muscles are consistent with pyomyositis, a condition characterized by a bacterial infection of the skeletal muscle.

rejected.label: Herpes Zoster
rejected.why: Although the patient reported severe pain in the right arm radiating to the shoulder, suggesting herpes zoster, the absence of vesicles and the presence of a focal cystic necrotic lesion on MRI make pyomyositis a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
rejected.why: While the patient was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, this diagnosis does not directly explain the severe pain in the right arm and the MRI findings.

rejected.label: Osteomyelitis
rejected.why: Osteomyelitis typically involves infection of the bone, but the MRI findings in this case suggest a soft tissue infection, making pyomyositis a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Septic Arthritis
rejected.why: Septic arthritis typically involves infection of a joint, but the MRI findings in this case suggest a soft tissue infection, making pyomyositis a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cellulitis
rejected.why: Cellulitis is a superficial skin infection, but the MRI findings in this case suggest a deeper tissue infection, making pyomyositis a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
rejected.why: The patient's diagnosis of acute lymphoblastic leukemia, not acute myeloid leukemia, makes this an unlikely explanation for the current symptoms.

rejected.label: Eczema Herpeticum
rejected.why: The patient's eczematous plaques were treated as contact dermatitis and resolved rapidly, making eczema herpeticum an unlikely explanation for the current symptoms.
